why.label: Why StackPay

why.subtitle: Zana nyingi za crypto huishia kwenye malipo tu. StackPay inaunganisha ufadhili, mapato, jumuiya na utoaji mahali pamoja — kwa sababu kukuza salio kunapaswa kuwa rahisi, kijamii na kurudiwa.

items.title: Crypto-native, si crypto-confusing
items.body: Lipa kwa MetaMask, pata mapato kwa salio la USD, na toa stablecoins — bila kuchanganya programu tano tofauti.

items.title: Built to grow with yako network

items.title: Unda yako akaunti

items.title: Fund with crypto

items.title: Invest & earn daily

privacy.title: Sera ya faragha
privacy.intro: Sera hii ya faragha inaeleza jinsi StackPay ("sisi") inavyokusanya, kutumia, kuhifadhi na kushiriki taarifa unapotumia tovuti yetu, programu na huduma husika ("Huduma").

s1.title: 1. Information we collect
paragraphs: Akaunti information: name, barua pepe anwani, simu number, username, nenosiri hash, profile image URL, and mialiko or referral relationships.
Usage and device data: app interactions, session tokenis, theme preferences, cookie consent choices, and technical logs such as IP anwani, browser type, and timestamps.
Transaction data: payment maombi, amana anwanies, blockchain transaction hashes, balances, package uwekezajis, utoajis, transfers, mkopos, and referral kamishenis.
Jumuiya content: messages, reactions, and profile information you chagua to shiriki in channels or direct messages.

s2.title: 2. How we use information
list: process payments, uwekezajis, utoajis, and referrals;
prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access;
improve reliability, performance, and user experience;
comply with legal obligations and enforce our Masharti of Use.

s3.title: 3. Cookies and local storage
s3.body: We use cookies and local storage to keep you signed in, remwanachama preferences such as theme, and store cookie consent choices. You can simamia non-essential cookies through the consent banner. Some features require essential storage to function.

s4.title: 4. How we shiriki information
s4.body: We do si sell yako personal information. We may shiriki data with service providers that help us operate the jukwaa (hosting, database, analytics), when inahitajika by law, to protect rights and safety, or in connection with a business transfer. Blockchain transaction data you submit is public by nature on the relevant network.

s5.title: 5. Data retention
s5.body: We retain akaunti and transaction records for as long as needed to provide the Service, meet legal and akauntiing requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. You may request akaunti deletion subject to legal retention obligations.

s6.title: 6. Security
s6.body: We use msimamiziistrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect yako information, including nenosiri hashing and access controls. Hakuna method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and you are responsible for safeguarding yako login credentials.

s7.title: 7. Yako choices
s7.body: You may update profile details in Settings, simamia cookie preferences through our consent banner, and contact us regarding access, correction, or deletion maombi where applicable law provides those rights.

s8.title: 8. International watumiaji
s8.body: If you access the Service from outside the country where our servers are located, yako information may be processed in jurisdictions with different data protection laws.

s9.title: 9. Children
s9.body: The Service is si intended for watumiaji under 18. We do si knowingly collect personal information from children.

s10.title: 10. Changes to this policy
s10.body: We may update this Faragha Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page will reflect the latest version. Continued use of the Service after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

terms.title: Masharti ya matumizi
terms.intro: Masharti haya ya matumizi ("Masharti") yanasimamia ufikiaji wako na matumizi ya StackPay, ikiwa ni pamoja na tovuti yetu, programu, zana za malipo, vifurushi, programu ya mialiko, mikopo, vipengele vya jumuiya na huduma husika ("Huduma"). Kwa kuunda akaunti, unakubali Masharti haya.

s1.title: 1. Eligibility
s1.body: You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to ingiza into a binding agreement. You are responsible for ensuring that yako use of the Service complies with applicable laws in yako jurisdiction, including rules related to digital assets, financial services, and taxation.

s2.title: 2. Akaunti registration
s2.body: You agree to provide accurate information when creating an akaunti and to keep yako credentials secure. You are responsible for zote shughuli under yako akaunti. We may suspend or terminate akauntis that violate these Masharti or pose a security or legal risk.

s3.title: 3. Crypto payments and balances
paragraphs: StackPay facilitates crypto payments and tracks USD-denominated balances within the jukwaa. Blockchain transactions are irreversible once confirmed. You are solely responsible for verifying pochi anwanies, networks, and tokeni types before sending funds.
Displayed rates, balances, and confirmations depend on network conditions and third-party data sources. We do si guarantee uninterrupted availability of any blockchain network.

s4.title: 4. Uwekezaji packages and mapato
paragraphs: Uwekezaji packages, projected returns, and accrual schedules are jukwaa features subject to change. Past performance does si guarantee future results. Kifurushi masharti, rates, and mudas are shown in the app at the time of purchase.
You acknowledge that digital asset uwekezajis carry risk, including the risk of partial or total loss of value.

s5.title: 5. Mialiko, mkopos, and utoajis
s5.body: Referral kamishenis, mkopo masharti, and utoaji inachakatwa are governed by the rules displayed in the Service at the time you use each feature. We may modify program rules, fees, limits, or eligibility with reasonable notice where inahitajika.

s6.title: 6. Jumuiya conduct
s6.body: When using community chat, direct messages, or other social features, you agree si to harass others, post unlawful content, attempt fraud, or interfere with the Service. We may ondoa content or restrict access to protect watumiaji and the jukwaa.

s7.title: 7. Prohibited use
s7.body: You may si use the Service for money laundering, sanctions evasion, unauthorized access, automated abuse, or any shughuli that violates applicable law. We may cooperate with law enforcement and block suspicious shughuli.

s8.title: 8. Disclaimers
s8.body: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent permitted by law. StackPay is si a bank, broker-dealer, or licensed financial adviser unless explicitly stated otherwise in yako jurisdiction.

s9.title: 9. Limitation of liability
s9.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, StackPay and its operators will si be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for losses arising from blockchain failures, user error, unauthorized akaunti access, or third-party services.
